time_scope: One worker's source-audit interval through report validation. Later metadata publication and separately logged implementation are outside this interval. Concurrent intervals do not add campaign elapsed time.
activity: Inspect official CUDA12.9.1 API contracts, installed12.9 headers, package metadata, ELF exports, and PyTorch graph lifetime documentation.
conclusion: Conditional bounded argument-value inspection is source-supported. Universal opaque-GEMM operand decoding and current cached-decode weight identity remain unresolved.

public_APIs.cudaGraphKernelNodeGetParams: Node-owned source-graph argument values and launch metadata. Lifetime ends on destruction or parameter change.
public_APIs.cudaFuncGetParamInfo: Per-index device-layout offset and byte size. No type or nested-field schema.
public_APIs.cuFuncGetParamInfo: Same metadata for a legitimate CUfunction.
public_APIs.cuKernelGetParamInfo: Same metadata for a legitimate CUkernel.

safe_boundary: Retain a valid source node and serialize graph access.
Use the matching API and exact structure version for the function handle.
Read an argument value only after its extent is established by a known signature or successful metadata query.
Use packed-buffer offsets only within the documented extra buffer extent.
Interpret a pointer field only with a verified ABI.
Match known tensor allocation ranges and view offsets without dereferencing device values.
Require source-to-executable provenance and no untracked updates.
unsafe_boundary: Scan kernelParams until a null value appears.
Read guessed fixed-width windows from unknown addresses.
Treat device-layout offsets as offsets within individual kernelParams entries.
Follow indirect device buffers, pointer arrays, or descriptors without a schema and version.
Decode opaque library GEMM structures from public BLAS call signatures.
Cast runtime host entry symbols to CUfunction without documented conversion.
Treat source graph values as an audit of arbitrary executable updates.
Infer HBM transactions or speedup from operand address equality.
